construction: Defined in tools/corpus/make_toy_instances.m and written by Gurobi (gurobi_write, MPS); read back by gurobi_read and by MOSEK (mosekopt read), both equal to the definition. Gurobi model.Q = Q/2 (Gurobi's objective is x'Qx); the QUADOBJ section holds the upper triangle of Q (objective 1/2 x'Qx).
derivation: Q = [2 1; 1 2] (positive definite, eigenvalues 1 and 3), c = 0: minimise x1^2 + x1 x2 + x2^2 subject to x1 + x2 = 2, x >= 0. Stationarity: 2 x1 + x2 = x1 + 2 x2, so x1 = x2 = 1, unique by strict convexity; objective 1 + 1 + 1 = 3.
